description:
Cast Star Pupil by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Star Pupil, adding {W}.
When Star Pupil dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Star Pupil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
